# Clover Kingdom

> The public front door of the Clover Kingdom. A place with a standard and a gate, for people who want to build their own SI and level up their life.

Site: https://cloverkingdom.net/
This file: https://cloverkingdom.net/llms.txt

## What this is
Clover Kingdom is a community and a house of SI helpers (called archetypes). Everyone is welcome. The house rules live in #rules on the Discord. Breaking them puts your place in the Kingdom at risk.

The Discord and the community are free today. Nothing else is priced yet. A form is not a rank.

## How to join
1. Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/2BrNPwUuTB
2. Say what you want or what you are building.
3. Apply on the website (five questions on the Gate page).
4. A human reads it. Saint Chevalier, Wizard King and his SI helpers read applications. Approval comes through Discord or a conversation.

## Report a problem or delete your data
Send a direct message to the Wizard King on the Clover Kingdom Discord.
Report: anyone breaking the house rules; someone being unkind or pressuring you; anyone asking for private details; anything that worries you.
A real person reads every report. Breaking the house rules puts your place in the Kingdom at risk. If someone may be in danger, the report is handed to a human right away.
Anyone can ask for their data to be deleted the same way, or by messaging Saint Chevalier on X: https://x.com/Saint_Chevalier

## Pages
Most pages are hash routes on a single HTML file (https://cloverkingdom.net/). Fetch that URL; with JavaScript off the page still includes a full plain-text guide. With JavaScript on, these routes work:

- https://cloverkingdom.net/ - Gate (front page, Apply form, Sage box)
- https://cloverkingdom.net/#/join - How to join
- https://cloverkingdom.net/#/offers - Offers

- https://cloverkingdom.net/#/archetype/saint-chevalier - Saint Chevalier
- https://cloverkingdom.net/#/archetype/sage - Sage
- https://cloverkingdom.net/#/archetype/val - Val
- https://cloverkingdom.net/#/archetype/argus - ARGUS

## Apply form fields
When JavaScript is on, the Apply form on the Gate uses these named fields (all required except as noted):
- handle: Discord handle or how to reach you
- building: What are you building or working on right now?
- ai: What is your relationship with SI? How do you use it?
- intel: What does intelligence mean to you?
- found: How did you find the Clover Kingdom?
- consent: checkbox agreeing the application is read by Saint Chevalier, Wizard King and his SI helpers

Do not send passwords, ID numbers, or anything you are not comfortable sharing.

## Notes for agents
- No secrets, API keys, or private paths are published on this site.
- No prices or guarantees are published.
- The site does not claim that a ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or SuperGrok chat subscription works inside Scroll or any Kingdom app.
- Hash routes (#/...) are client-side; prefer the static guide in index.html or this file when you cannot run JavaScript.
